description: Fork of exp183 (E=96, val_bpb=1.6284 @ 302M, BitAttention + V2D on QK). Three changes: (1) d_qk: 32 -> 64. (2) Remove qk_v2d; Q and K taken directly from the joint QK LUT 128-dim output, split as 64|64. (3) Replace BitAttention with F.scaled_dot_product_attention. Scale becomes attn_scale / sqrt(d_qk) = attn_scale / 8 (was attn_scale / sqrt(496)). out_v2d / out_d2v rank canonicalization preserved. Tests whether the V2D dominance projection on Q/K was helping or hurting once we have a big unembedder + LUT trunk.
